seoTitle: Social Share Link Generator for X, LinkedIn, Facebook and More
metaDescription: Build share links for X, LinkedIn, Facebook, WhatsApp, Reddit, Bluesky, Telegram and email from a URL and title. Free, no scripts.
intro: Build "share this page" links for X, LinkedIn, Facebook, WhatsApp, Reddit, Bluesky, Telegram and email from a URL and a title.
why:
Official share buttons load scripts from the platforms and track visitors. A plain link does the same job without that.

Enter the page URL and an optional title, hashtags and X handle. The tool builds a properly encoded share link for each network and, if you like, ready-to-paste HTML with rel=noopener. These formats are the commonly used public ones. They were not opened or checked here, and platforms change them, so test each link once.
howTo: Add a title, hashtags and handle if you want.
Copy the links or the HTML.
Click each one once to test it.

faq.a: They load third-party scripts that can track visitors. Plain links do not.
Platforms change formats. Test each one before you publish.
